title: Epidemiological-Economical Pandemic Management By A Spatio-Temporal Mathematical Model
short_title: Epidemic-Economic Pandemic Management by a Spatio-Temporal Model
journal: Dynamical Systems Applied To Biology And Natural Science
abstract: We present a model that considers the severity of the disease and the heterogeneity of contacts between the population in complex space-time dynamics.
summary: We present a mathematical model for pandemic management that considers how severe the disease is and how unevenly people in a population come into contact with each other, within complex dynamics over space and time.
key_findings: The model considers the severity of the disease.
It accounts for heterogeneity of contacts within the population in complex space-time dynamics.
